comments: Hello Elizabeth, Jim and I have new volunteers to help us out this year on Hawkins Pond. They are Jackie and Bruce Courtemanche. Jackie has gone out on the pond twice with me and I have shown her the procedures. Today she filtered the water and I ran through all the procedures with her again. She has watched the videos. I made a copy of the handbook for her to read and refer to. She will monitor the next 2 weeks without my help but will call me if she has questions. She will send in her paperwork shortly or will bring it with her the week of July 4 for the second collection. Our pond looks good, it was treated for invasive weeds a few weeks ago. Have a good weekend!Lisa and Jim Murphy
